s: Din tepillat mincha beshabbat ubo z' seipim: nohagin lomar achar "ashre" qodem tepillat mincha "uba letziyyon goel" vekol seder qedushsha bimqom seder qedushsha sheomerim bekol yom babboqer, ella shebbeshabbat veyom tob shemmaarikim bitpillat shacharit umusap — hinnichuhu ad hammincha:

Ezra tiqqen sheyyihyu g' anashim qorin beseper tora betzibbur bekol shabbat bemincha asara pesuqim o yoter mipparashat shabua habba, bishbil yoshebe qeranot hammitasseqim bischora kol yemot hashshabua veenam baim lishmoa qeriat hattora besheni vachamishi, lepikak tiqqen bishbilam qeria yetera beshabbat bemincha shehem penuyim veyabou lishmoa. Vaapillu im chal yom tob lihyot beshabbat qoreim beparashat shabua habba velo beparashat yom tob, sheen inyan leyom tob kelal liqriat hattora bemincha, shehare ilmale shabbat en qeriat hattora beyom tob bemincha:

Venohagin lomar qodem qeriat hattora pasuq "vaani tepillati vego'", al pi mah sheddareshu chakamim al pasuq "yasichu bi yoshebe shaar uneginot shote shekar", vekatub acharayv "vaani tepillati vego'", amar david lipne haqqadosh baruk hu, ribbono shel olam, en umma zo kishar ummot haolam, ummot haolam keshehem shotim umishtakkerim holekin upochazin, veanav lo ken, ella ap al pi sheshshatinu "vaani tepillati vego'". Ulekak hinhigu lomar ken qodem qeriat hattora sheqqorin bishbil yoshebe qeranot, kede lehodot leyotzerenu shello sam chelqenu kahem, shehem pochazin kol hayyom, veanu ap hayyoshebe qeranot shebbanu mitassepim lishmoa tora. Ubeyom tob shechal bechol en nohagin leomro, hoil veen qorein bo battora bemincha. Umittaam zeh gam beshabbat bemaqom sheen seper tora en tzarik leomro, ella shennahagu beshabbat leomro bekol inyan:

En omerim qaddish achar qeriat hattora bemincha, sheen kan bammeh lehapsiq ben qaddish zeh leqaddish sheomerim qodem tepilla belachash, sheap shennohagim lomar "yehalelu", mikkol maqom pasuq echad hu veeno chashub hepseq, veasur lomar b' qaddeshim zeh achar zeh belo hepseq pesuqim benetayim. Lepikak, bemaqom sheen bo seper tora, sheen sham hepseq ben qaddish shelleachar "uba letziyyon" leqaddish sheqqodem hattepilla belachash — lo yomru ella qaddish echad, she"vaani tepillati" eno ella pasuq echad veeno chashub hepseq. Vetob sheaz lo yomru kelal "vaani tepillati", o yomruhu qodem haqqaddish miyyad achar siyyum seder qedushsha, kede shello lehapsiq kelal ben haqqaddish litpilla belachash apillu bepasuq echad, shelleolam en anu matchilin tepilla belo qaddish lepaneha, chutz mittepillat hashshachar, mippene semikat geulla litpilla:
Nohagim lomar g' pesuqim "tzidqateka", vehem keen tzidduq haddin al g' tzaddiqim shennipteru beshaa zo, yosep, mosheh vedavid:

Venahagu shello liqboa midrash ben mincha lemaarib, ki chakam shemmet bet midrasho batel, dehaynu sheenam lomedim bachabura. Abal shenayim shenayim lomedim bebattehem, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman shd"m. Velaken hamminhag lidrosh qodem mincha. Veim nimsheka hadderasha ad samuk lachasheka shello yukelu leqayyem seudda shelishit — azay lo yomru pirqe abot o "shir hammaalot":

Im chal beshabbat yom sheen omerim bo nepilat appayim bemincha im haya chal bechol, kegon chanukka verosh chodesh — en nohagin lomar "tzidqateka"-"vetzidqateka"-"tzidqateka" bemincha. Veken im rosh chodesh lemachar — en nohagin lomar "tzidqateka"- "vetzidqateka"-"tzidqateka" bemincha, shehare bechol gam ken en nohagin lomar nepilat appayim beereb rosh chodesh bemincha:
